categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and edits release flags in depends/hosts/linux.mk and depends/hosts/mingw32.mk.
categories.rationale: Adds compile-time fortification (`-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3` and `-fstack-clash-protection`) to third-party dependencies built via depends for Linux and Windows. This provides valuable defense-in-depth security hardening against buffer overflows in static dependencies like SQLite and ZeroMQ, though it is reasonably deferrable as it does not address active breakage or an immediate vulnerability.
